summary: The Lord will smite and destroy Egypt—Finally He will heal her, and Egypt and Assyria will be blessed with Israel.
meta_description: The Lord will smite and destroy Egypt—Finally He will heal her, and Egypt and Assyria will be blessed with Israel.

footnotes.note1_a: IE a message of doom “lifted up” against Egypt.
footnotes.note10_a: HEB her foundations shall be crushed.
footnotes.note15_a: IE the different levels of society.
footnotes.note18_a: HEB Heres; possibly “of the sun”; perhaps Heliopolis, one of the oldest cities of the Nile delta.
footnotes.note24_a: IE all three will be allied, with Israel as a blessing in the midst of them.
